rows.64:32ac:
...See, it's right there, isn't it?
If Onoda, who wrote this note, was the thief behind the thefts in our class...
then it means Onoda thought they'd been seen by Shimada or me, and committed suicide over it.
Even though we never saw anyone else at all...{p}
rows.64:33a4:
Did you know?
They say people with a guilty conscience fear other people more than they need to.
I bet Onoda saw us there that time and figured we'd spotted them too.
And then, looking back on what they'd been doing all along, Onoda suddenly got terrified.
...That's only my guess, though.{p}
